commentaries.author: वामन-जयादित्यौ
commentaries.content: अपस्कर इति निपात्यते रथाङ्गं चेद् भवति। अपपूर्वात् किरतेः <<ॠदोरप्>> [[३.३.५७]] इत्यप्, निपातनात् सुट्। अपस्करो रथावयवः। रथाङ्गमिति किम् ? अपकरः॥

commentaries.author: हरदत्तः
commentaries.content: अत्र सूत्रे तृतीय उपसर्गः, पूर्वत्र षष्ठः ॥

commentaries.author: S.C. Vasu
commentaries.content:
The word अपस्कर is formed by सुट् meaning 'the part of a chariot'.
This word is also derived from कृ with the proposition अप and the affix अप् [[3.3.57]] and सुट् augment. When not having this meaning, we have अपकरः ॥

commentaries.author: S.C. Vasu
commentaries.content: The word अपस्कर is formed by सुट् meaning 'the part of a chariot'.
